name: Chord Diagram
summary: Bilateral flows within one set of entities — arcs sized by two-way volume, ribbons from source to target (cross-border M&A, trade corridors).
summary_zh: 同一组实体之间的双向流量：圆弧长度为双向总量，弦带连接来源与去向（跨境并购、贸易走廊、业务单元间转介）。
description_zh: 每行数据是一条流向（source → target，value 为金额，可选 count 为笔数），相同的来源-去向对会自动汇总，排名靠后的实体合并为“Other”。圆弧长度代表该实体作为来源与去向的合计流量，弦带两端的宽度代表该方向的流量，弦带颜色默认取来源方（例如收购方国家）。适合展示 6–15 个实体之间的相互流动关系，例如跨境并购的收购方国家 → 目标国家；悬停弦带可看到双向对比，点击圆弧可聚焦并交叉筛选。
best_for: Cross-border M&A: acquirer country → target country
Trade or capital flows between regions
avoid_when: Flows between two different sets with a clear direction of stages (use sankey)
When exact values matter more than the overall pattern (use a matrix / heatmap)

value.desc: Flow size (summed per source → target pair)

count.desc: Optional count shown in tooltips (e.g. number of deals)

top.desc: Keep the N largest entities by two-way total; the rest are grouped into 'Other' (0 = keep all)

includeSelf.desc: Keep flows where source == target (e.g. domestic deals)

sort.desc: Arc order clockwise from 12 o'clock: desc (largest first) | data

colorBy.desc: node: categorical colour per entity | single: spotlight — accent arcs, ribbons touching the highlight emphasised, others faded

nodeColors.desc: {name: colour} — theme token ('accent2', 'cat3' …) or CSS colour

highlight.desc: Entity name(s) drawn in accent2 (e.g. the client's home market). colorBy node: the highlighted arc and all its ribbons take accent2 at a moderate opacity while every other ribbon recedes; colorBy single: its inbound / outbound ribbons are told apart by a direction key

minLabelShare.desc: Hide labels of arcs below this share of the total (shown on hover)

colorKey.desc: Reading key, top-left: 'Ribbon colour = …' (+ a 10px swatch for the highlighted flows), or with colorBy single + highlight an outbound / inbound swatch key

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

crossFilter.desc: Click an arc to focus its flows and filter other blocks on the source field

crossFilterScope.desc: dataset: the selection only filters blocks bound to the same dataset | global

filterScope.desc: Deprecated alias of crossFilterScope (still honoured when set)

interactions: Hover an arc: adjacency emphasis + outbound / inbound / net tooltip
Hover a ribbon: flow value, count and reverse flow
Click an arc to focus and cross-filter (click again to clear)
Re-lays out on resize and filter changes

samples.title: Cross-border industrials M&A, 2021–2026 YTD (USD bn) — acquirer to target country
Spotlight on Germany — inbound and outbound corridors
